study_design: 1:1 matched case-control study with retrospective dietary assessment
reason: The study evaluates histologically confirmed prostate cancer overall in a case-control design. The abstract does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The multivariable adjusted ORs were 1.65 (95% confident interval (CI) 1.39-1.96) for lipid, 1.22 (95% CI 1.13-1.31) for carbohydrates, 3.21 (95% CI 2.18-4.75) for retinol, 0.61 (95% CI 0.6-0.80) for vitamin C, and 0.029 (95% CI 0.009-0.09) for vitamin B1.
estimate_classifications.reason: The retinol estimate concerns prostate cancer overall, with no aggressive disease definition.
